name: habits
description: Agentic habits in three tiers: stated rules placed where their trigger fires, gates that make the ones that must not fail deterministic, and a read-only judge that scores adherence from evidence. Ships a working Stop hook, 20 starter habits, and 12 named anti-habits.

metadata.tools: The skill reads and writes markdown, and proposes hook configuration. The judge subagent is restricted to Read, Grep and Glob, which is what makes its verdict independent.

permissions.filesystem: Writes to a user's instruction files only after showing the exact content and receiving an explicit yes. install.sh stages files and never writes a habit.
permissions.settings: Never edits settings.json without --apply and an explicit yes. The Stop gate is proposed, never silently installed.
permissions.network: The shipped skill, the gate and the installer make no network call. One development script, .github/live-checks/rules-canary.sh, invokes the claude CLI and therefore the API; it is not installed and never runs in CI.
permissions.credentials: Never read, never stored, never written to a habit file or a case.
